quests.hint: Stress 'tomorrow' and 'today' against each other.
quests.explanation: Stress both halves of the correction — the wrong idea you're denying, and the truth you're stating.
quests.textToSpeak: I didn't say tomorrow, I said today.
quests.phoneticHint: Emphasize 'tomorrow' (denied) and 'today' (the correction).

quests.hint: Stress 'fail' and 'passed' against each other.
quests.explanation: Give strong emphasis to what you're correcting and what you're replacing it with.
quests.textToSpeak: I didn't fail the test, I passed it.
quests.phoneticHint: Emphasize 'fail' (denied) and 'passed' (the correction).

quests.hint: Stress 'cancel' and 'rescheduled' against each other.

quests.phoneticHint: Emphasize 'cancel' (denied) and 'rescheduled' (the correction).

quests.hint: Stress 'miss' and 'caught' against each other.
quests.explanation: Push extra weight onto the corrected fact — that's the whole point of this contrastive sentence.
quests.textToSpeak: We didn't miss the flight, we caught it.
quests.phoneticHint: Emphasize 'miss' (denied) and 'caught' (the correction).

quests.hint: Stress 'forget' and 'planned a surprise' against each other.

quests.phoneticHint: Emphasize 'forget' (denied) and 'planned a surprise' (the correction).
